name: done-ping
description: A notification when a long turn finishes or Claude waits on you (permission or a question): the desktop app's own notification where it can, else a macOS banner with project, what happened and a short detail

thresholdSeconds.title: Threshold (seconds)
thresholdSeconds.description: A finished turn pings only when it ran at least this long

pingOnPermission.title: Ping when waiting
pingOnPermission.description: Also ping when Claude asks for permission or asks you a question

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: A macOS system sound by name (Glass, Hero, Ping, Purr, Submarine, Funk, Pop), a path to a sound file, or none

quietWhenFocused.title: Quiet while you look
quietWhenFocused.description: Skip the banner while the app this session runs in (Claude, your terminal) is the frontmost app

appNotification.title: Use the app's notification
appNotification.description: In the desktop app, notify through Claude's own notification (Claude icon) when it is available without a prompt
